Oriental Cafe in Killeen #localfood 

Bill stopped by one of his go-to lunch spots in Killeen — Oriental Café — for his usual garlic chicken with rice and an egg roll. As always, the food was hot, flavorful, and fast, and the staff greeted him like family. Great service, consistent quality, and fair prices are exactly why this place stays on his favorites list.
